metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-a5[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make Agents-tab `v` view hints load fast[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `v` on the Agents tab paints the hint input bar [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]immediately and renders numbered hints in bounded, cached, off-pump[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]work, so hint latency stops scaling with transcript size, family [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]member count, or auto-refresh cadence.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]agents_view_hints_perf.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Instrument and baseline the view-hints keypath[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]measure[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]measure: add end-to-end trace spans for the `v` keypath, add a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]view-hints scenario to the TUI trace bench, capture a committed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]baseline, and document the new spans in the perf runbook. No behavior [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]change.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bound hint-mode content and remove per-fragment disk work[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bound[dim] · [dim][/dim]after measure[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bound: apply the normal render path's byte/line caps to hint-mode body [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]content (including family member fragments), hoist per-chunk workspace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolution out of the family hint loop, and memoize hint path [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolution.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Paint the hint bar before rendering the annotated document[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]offpump[dim] · [dim][/dim]after measure[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]offpump: restructure the view-files action so the hint input bar mounts [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]first and the annotated render runs as a pump-free task, with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]readiness guard so an early submission still resolves against complete [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hint mappings.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cache the annotated hint document[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cache[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bound[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cache: memoize the hint render result and wrap the annotated document in[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a width-keyed cached renderable so repeat presses, refresh repaints, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-enrichment repaints reuse rendered segments.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop redundant hint re-renders on refresh and enrichment[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]dedupe[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cache, offpump[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]dedupe: skip the full hint document rebuild on Agents-tab refreshes and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]header-enrichment messages whose inputs did not change, and stop the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]one-second summary TTL from forcing repeated enrichment while hint mode [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is active.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify the speedup and guard it[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after dedupe[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: re-run the view-hints bench against the committed baseline, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record the after numbers, add a regression floor, and sync the help [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]popup and perf runbook with any user-visible behavior change.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
